resources.string: Cache comments and translations during download

When an offline video finishes downloading, fetch its comment pages and replies and pretranslate while connected. This switch separately permits background comment/translation requests, even in local-only playback mode. Retains per-video originals and translations across restarts; no LRU expiry. Incomplete requests are not marked complete. Captions are not included yet. Stored under the host private offline companion directory. Retained until manual clear of all offline videos; uninstalling or clearing app data can remove it.
Scan already-downloaded videos while connected and fill missing comments/translations. Requires download comment caching.
Backfill on opening an offline video
For old downloads only: enqueue missing comments/translations when viewed while connected. New downloads always use the download-completion callback.
Comments and translations are saved for offline reading.
Offline comment cache is incomplete; missing translations need an online retry. Existing originals remain readable.
